answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own plume record, and its own share of the raven quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The falcon ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 2876 identities would post 3896 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
